comment: Known disagreements scripts/formal/refdiff-harness.py --ci accepts. Each rule names the harness classes it covers; `pointer` (exact), `pointer_suffix` and `verdict`, when present, must match the record (`verdict`: both records'); `requires: alias-loop` is checked by the harness: a record must name, as its owner pair or a ref: value, a component in an alias loop or leading into one, on either side. See formal/README.md, "Reference semantics of `$ref` diffs", Known limits.

rules.name: Q1: content-free alias loop (C = {"$ref": C}, or a ref cycle with no content) facing an undeclared ref or inline schema: the model takes the fixpoint, the Rust compares the literal $ref; one Review record at a $ref key either way
#186: the Rust follows component references outside the schema grammar (default, if, prefixItems, $defs, ...) and rates what it finds there by the direction table; the model does not follow them
